patch_description: This redesign separates the search into three modules: structured/island initialization, fast incremental stochastic exploration, and analytic signed-determinant epigraph polishing. Multiple template families diversify the oriented-matroid cells explored, while only affected triangle areas are recomputed during annealing. The best island configurations are then passed to SLSQP with analytic derivatives, allowing precise resolution of active maximin constraints without relying solely on random perturbations. A deterministic annealing-only fallback remains available if SciPy is unavailable or optimization fails.
